mechanical_parameters.control_matching: nearest-3 control windows per case window by |mean CA SASA difference|, deterministic, ties by lower start
mechanical_parameters.exposure_source_rule: deposited antigen chain when it spans the case window plus >=5 residues on one side and >=L+5 total; else the parent own structure (NMR model or AFDB model); deviation from the frozen bound-chain proxy is recorded per parent
mechanical_parameters.precedent_universe: every chain sequence of the local pool CIFs plus queue component sequences; precedent = exact substring match of the window
